name: final-vision-smoke

serve.command: exec env -i HOME=/home/spark USER=spark LOGNAME=spark PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin RUST_BACKTRACE=1 /home/spark/inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark/bin/rexl3-serve --model /home/spark/models/Inkling-2-Mini-SAGE-REXL3-4.23bpw --max-model-len 262144 --slots 4 --kv-tokens 1048576 --prefill-chunk 4096 --kv-dtype int8 --spec dspark --prefix-cache on --allow-unvalidated-pack --served-model-name inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

tests.filter: image red-square: the reply names the colour(s)
image blue-circle: the reply names the colour(s)
image green-yellow: the reply names the colour(s)
image replies equal the pinned reply-vision.json replies (ids and finish reason)
text replies equal the pinned reference-vision.json replies
image: a red square on white is named red (boot p)

commands: ./inkling2mini.sh bench all   (boot g: gates.py vision against bench/reference-vision.json)
notes: VISION=on at the shipping defaults (drafter and prefix cache on as well). The reference-vision.json replies were pinned by boot p; boot g reproduced them byte for byte (token ids and finish reasons of three synthetic images and four text prompts).
